zh.donate_lead: 線上捐款系統說明 · Online Donation
zh.donate_intro: 佛光山三寶寺是一處奉行人間佛教的菩薩道場，以文化、教育、慈善與共修弘法利生。您的每一分護持，都將匯聚成河，成就道場弘法的資糧，點亮世間的每一盞心燈。秉持「給人信心、給人歡喜、給人希望、給人方便」的精神，三寶寺設置安全便捷的線上捐款，讓十方大眾輕鬆種福田、共成無量功德。

donate_notes.text: 線上捐款透過 PayPal 安全付款；Zelle 轉帳請依下方說明操作，款項將直接匯入美國佛教文化協會帳戶。
完成 PayPal 捐款後，系統將自動寄送電子收據至您的電子信箱。
如需開立正式捐款收據，請於捐款後來信 sanbao@ibps.org，並提供姓名、地址與捐款資訊。
選擇不具名捐款者，將視同以「三寶弟子」為捐款人，日後恕無法提供開立收據及捐款查詢服務。

donate_funds.label: 建寺功德
donate_funds.desc: 護持道場修建與維護，成就莊嚴清淨的修行空間。

donate_funds.label: 法會功德
donate_funds.desc: 護持法會、共修與弘法活動，廣結善緣。

donate_funds.label: 隨喜功德
donate_funds.desc: 隨喜布施，護持道場日常運作與利生事業。

zh.donate_consent: 我已詳細閱讀以上注意事項，並了解捐款相關事宜，將進行捐款。
zh.donate_zelleInfo: Zelle 收款資訊（待補）：請於 App 中以收款 Email／電話轉帳，並於附註填寫您所選擇的功德項目與姓名。完成後可來信 sanbao@ibps.org 告知，以利開立收據。
zh.donate_hint: 捐款將於新分頁開啟 PayPal 安全頁面。請先勾選上方同意事項後，再選擇付款方式。
zh.sub_desc: 留下您的電子郵件，第一時間收到法會、講座與活動通知。
zh.support_text: 佛光山是一個行人間佛教的菩薩道場，如果您喜歡我們的宗風，認同我們的理念，歡迎您隨喜贊助。涓滴的護持將會匯集成大河，成為我們繼續前進的動力。
zh.c_thanks: 感謝您對佛光山三寶寺的支持與愛護，如果您對網頁有任何問題，歡迎提出意見及相關問題，讓我們有機會提供給您更好的服務。

en.tour_desc: Step inside this contemporary monastery on Van Ness Avenue. Behind the quiet stone-lattice facade lie the main shrine, the meditation hall and a cultural lecture space — a cool refuge in the midst of the city.
en.founder_quote: When the Buddha is in your heart, everything you see is the Buddha.
en.founder_desc: Venerable Master Hsing Yun devoted his life to “Humanistic Buddhism,” spreading the Dharma through culture, education, charity and shared practice. The temple carries forward his vision, bringing the calm of the Dharma into everyday San Francisco.
en.vol_intro: Volunteers are the warmest force in the temple. Several volunteer teams welcome you to join according to your interests and skills — cultivating merit and wisdom through service.

vol_groups.desc: Keeping records, publicity and archives — preserving the temple’s journey of spreading the Dharma.

vol_groups.desc: Coordinating logistics and venues so every activity runs smoothly.

vol_groups.name: Environmental
vol_groups.desc: Promoting recycling and cleanliness, putting care for the earth into practice.

vol_groups.desc: Welcoming and guiding visitors with a warm smile, forming good affinities with all.

en.donate_lead: Instructions for Donating Online · 線上捐款
en.donate_intro: Three Treasures Temple is a Humanistic Buddhist monastery serving through culture, education, charity and shared practice. Every gift, however small, gathers like drops into a great river — sustaining the Dharma and lighting a lamp in every heart. In the spirit of “giving others confidence, joy, hope and convenience,” the temple offers a safe and simple way to give online, so all may plant seeds of merit together.

donate_notes.text: Online gifts are processed securely through PayPal; for Zelle, please follow the instructions below. All funds go directly to the American Buddhist Cultural Society.
After a PayPal donation, an electronic receipt is automatically emailed to you.
For a formal donation receipt, email sanbao@ibps.org after donating with your name, address and gift details.
Anonymous donations are recorded under “Triple Gem disciple”; receipts and donation look-ups cannot be provided afterward.
